text: BAM share fell 0.07 percentage points over 24 hours, though it remains up 0.3 percentage points over 7 days at 34.5%. Current leadership reflects whale-driven routing: ams-mainnet-bam-1-tee holds 21.8% of BAM stake, and concentration remains elevated with the node Nakamoto coefficient at 3. Recent precursor signals appeared for new tyo-mainnet-bam-dev-tee and ams-mainnet-bam-dev, but this is not evidence of another structural rollover.
